guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Claim Test ETH from the Faucet
guide.description: Open the Robinhood Chain Testnet Faucet , enter your wallet address, and request test ETH. You need it for gas and for trading on the testnet.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Claim Test ETH from the Faucet
guide.original_description: Open the Robinhood Chain Testnet Faucet , enter your wallet address, and request test ETH. You need it for gas and for trading on the testnet.

guide.title: Connect Your Wallet to Vibe Vibe
guide.description: Go to the Vibe Vibe testnet and connect your EVM wallet. If your wallet asks you to add or switch to Robinhood Chain Testnet, approve it.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Connect Your Wallet to Vibe Vibe
guide.original_description: Go to the Vibe Vibe testnet and connect your EVM wallet. If your wallet asks you to add or switch to Robinhood Chain Testnet, approve it.

guide.title: Create a Testnet Token
guide.description: Click the launch option and fill in the details: Token name and ticker Token image (required) A short description of the project Put some effort into it, because the team says quality launches count.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Click the launch option and fill in the details: Token name and ticker Token image (required) A short description of the project Put some effort into it, because the team says quality launches count.

guide.title: Buy and Sell Testnet Tokens
guide.description: Trade tokens launched by other users. Buy early on the bonding curve and sell into strength, since high PnL is one of the listed eligibility criteria.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Trade tokens launched by other users. Buy early on the bonding curve and sell into strength, since high PnL is one of the listed eligibility criteria.

guide.title: Join the Telegram Raiding Channel
guide.description: Join the Vibe Vibe Telegram and take part in raids on X. You need a verified X account, and the top 250 raiders qualify for a free Vibe Vibers NFT.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Join the Vibe Vibe Telegram and take part in raids on X. You need a verified X account, and the top 250 raiders qualify for a free Vibe Vibers NFT.

guide.title: Apply for a Vibe Vibers Whitelist
guide.description: Follow the Vibe Vibers page for mint updates. Creators who make memes or other content can apply for collab spots when the form opens, with free mint whitelists awarded based on quality.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Apply for a Vibe Vibers Whitelist
guide.original_description: Follow the Vibe Vibers page for mint updates. Creators who make memes or other content can apply for collab spots when the form opens, with free mint whitelists awarded based on quality.
